source.label: U.S. Figure Skating, 2026-27 Singles Test Requirements chart (Version 1.0, 02/27/26)

note: Our own short summary of the free skate part of each test. Always check the current rulebook and ask your coach: the chart has more detail and it changes each season.

items.text: A waltz jump or a single Axel
